'''Osenrein''' is a satellite village of [[Tar Valon]], on the eastern bank of the river [[Erinin]], were one of the six bridges of the city connects the island to the continent.{{ref|{{twotc}}, Osenrein}}

Because Tar Valon is often the target of attacks and sieges, Osenrein has been a victim of many burnings over the years.
